entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Tokyo National Research Institute for Cultural Properties , commonly known as Tobunken, is an institute dedicated to the preservation and utilization of cultural properties. It is one of the two institutes in Japan that comprise the National Institutes for Cultural Heritage, an independent administrative institution created in 2001.
